description: This file is a server-side entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests, distinguishing between bot and browser user agents, and rendering server responses via streaming.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, distinguishes between OPTIONS requests, bots, and browsers, and delegates to specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from bots (user-agent detection), streaming the rendered response using React's server rendering.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from browsers, rendering the response accordingly.
